scope: Nagoya TV Tower in April 2011, with silver steel legs and tapering lattice, the elevated lower floors, enclosed viewing deck, open upper balcony and broadcast antenna arrays.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: The national register gives a 178.7 m height, 35 m leg span and 90 m observation deck.
The operator records the outdoor balcony at 100 m and the end of analog service in 2011.
The city gives 24 July 2011 as the end of analog broadcasting.

primaryWrittenSources.url: https://www.usao.jp/usao/内藤多仲カルテ/資料全部/カルテ6-1-1.pdf
primaryWrittenSources.facts: The engineering case study records a square open steel tower, 15–26 m suspended three-floor block, paired concrete diagonal support arches, and an upper antenna stage above 135 m.
